unitPrice.description: Frozen at reservation time, like an invoice line — does not recompute if the listing's price changes later.

priority.description: True when the buyer paid at reservation time — a paid reservation is never bumped by a later one.

paymentDeadline.description: Set only on an unpaid (priority=false) reservation; the worker cancels it and restores capacity once this passes.

payment.description: Embedded escrow sub-document — no separate payments collection.
